description: This file defines the LogExtentBuilder class, a mutable builder for creating log segments in a journaling system, including methods for appending entries, copying data, and managing internal buffers.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating log segments, supporting appending entries, copying data, and buffer management.

methods.name: ToArray
methods.description: Converts the current buffer contents to a byte array.

methods.name: CreateLogWriter
methods.description: Creates a new StateMachineStorageWriter for a given StateMachineId.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer and clears internal state.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the builder, resetting its state.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies the buffer contents to a stream with specified buffer size.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Synchronously copies the buffer contents to a stream with specified buffer size.
